_note: Batch 3 — dental support organizations (DSOs). Imported via import-to-airtable.mjs; businesses land review_status=pending, spot-check then flip to verified. DECISION (firm-only, ownership-focused): tags live on firms and every business inherits all of them, so tags are attached ONLY where they don't bleed across a firm's businesses. Aspen's two Tier A AG settlements are attached to Ares Management (Ares owns only Aspen in our data → no bleed); Leonard Green is a genuine co-owner of Aspen but is NOT used as the owning firm here because it also owns Wrench Group (HVAC) and the dental tags would bleed onto it. The Kool Smiles/Benevis $23.9M DOJ False Claims Act settlement (2018) was deliberately OMITTED: the conduct (2009-2011) and settlement predate New Mountain Capital's 2020 bankruptcy acquisition — same prior-ownership call we made for ARS/GI Partners in Batch 2. CAVEAT: Heartland Dental is owned by KKR, which already carries a PetVet-specific 'Financial extraction' tag from Batch 1; because the firm-only model inherits all firm tags, Heartland will display that PetVet tag. If that misattribution isn't acceptable, keep Heartland review_status=pending. National chains have no locations enumerated (deferred).

firms.notes: Co-majority owner of Aspen Dental Management (with Leonard Green & Partners; American Securities holds a minority stake).

tags.description: Massachusetts AG settlement announced Jan 5, 2023 ($3.5M): resolved a 2021 lawsuit alleging Aspen Dental used bait-and-switch advertising — charging patients for exams/x-rays/screenings it advertised as free and claiming to accept all insurance when it did not accept MassHealth Medicaid. Aspen agreed to return up to $750K to affected patients.

California AG settlement (May 2026): Aspen agreed to $2M in penalties plus $300K restitution over alleged illegal corporate practice of dentistry and false/misleading advertising, with injunctive terms barring it from directing clinical practice or replacing practice-owner dentists of its choosing.

firms.notes: Owns two DSOs: Benevis/Kool Smiles (acquired out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2020) and Western Dental / Sonrava Health (held since 2012).
Owner of Smile Brands (originally acquired 2016, sold, re-acquired 2024).
